svg.title: PLANNING GUIDE: CARE APARTMENT
svg.text: STANDARDS SHEET 05 · CARE · ELDERLY CARE HOME (SÄBO)
PLANNING GUIDE:
CARE APARTMENT
SOURCES
strength · confidence (see data/catalogue/README.md)
[PROGRAMME · verified]
Uppsala funktionsprogram 2021 p. 16: 'Lägenheten bör vara 30-35 kvm' (hall, sleeping/living room with pentry, bathroom). Göteborg förstudie
Önneredsvägen p. 4: 32-35 m² LOA. Botkyrka 2017 p. 7 and p. 20: minimum 31 m², about 31-40 m².
apartment 30–35 m² — https://www.uppsala.se/contentassets/7608aa284a64481bb52150f3fa6ee3a7/funktionsprogram-for-nytt-vard--och-omsorgsboende-for-aldre_slutversion_210924.pdf
[PROGRAMME · verified]
Ceiling height 2600 mm, 'motivated by ceiling-track hoist': Botkyrka 2017 p. 52. Bed 900 mm free on both sides in care position: Botkyrka p.
20. Hall turning 1300 mm minimum, preferably 1500 mm: Botkyrka p. 20. Doors used by residents 1100 mm frame and 1000 mm clear at 90°:
Botkyrka p. 45. Ceiling hoist: Uppsala p. 17, 'Rummet ska vara utrustat med travers'; Botkyrka p. 53, ceiling structure prepared for hoists
in apartment and bathroom; Göteborg Morans 2022, primary and secondary hoist beams in each apartment. Daylight and facade: dwelling
requirement (Uppsala p. 16, view out from bed and wheelchair). AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 6 §: normally at least 0.8 m free working space where care
work involves force or bending.
ceiling 2 600, bed 900, hall Ø 1 300 / 1 500, door 1 000, hoist —
https://www.botkyrka.se/download/18.13554ca8173e7b670d1ec11/1598379351184/Riktlinjer%20f%C3%B6r%20lokalfunktionsprogram%20f%C3%B6r%20s%C3%A4rskilda%20boenden%20m%20m.pdf
[PROGRAMME · verified]
Botkyrka 2017 p. 23: 'måtten skall vara 2,4 x 2,7 meter' with space to assist on both sides of WC and shower. Uppsala p. 17: room for two
staff assisting, plus washing machine and tumble dryer. BOV 2025 (SFVH) p. 134: every SÄBO apartment needs its own hygiene room with room for
washer and dryer.
bathroom 2.4 × 2.7 m —
https://www.botkyrka.se/download/18.13554ca8173e7b670d1ec11/1598379351184/Riktlinjer%20f%C3%B6r%20lokalfunktionsprogram%20f%C3%B6r%20s%C3%A4rskilda%20boenden%20m%20m.pdf
[LAW · —]
SoL 8 kap. 4 § creates the housing form. BFS 2024:11 2 kap. 1 §: a dwelling must be designed for the dwelling functions (sleep/rest, socialising, cooking,
meals, hygiene, storage). 2 kap. 10 §: in SÄBO with boendeenheter, socialising, cooking and meals may be shared only partly, as a complement to the
functions in each unit. BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 10 §: free space for assistance along both long sides and the foot of at least one bed, in each boendeenhet. BFS
2024:12 3 kap. 2 §: stretcher transport must be possible from each boendeenhet.
why the space is required — https://rinfo.boverket.se/BFS2024-11/pdf/BFS2024-11.pdf
[PROGRAMME · verified]
Uppsala kommun, Funktionsprogram för nytt vård- och omsorgsboende för äldre (2021)
hoist ('travers'), view from bed and wheelchair —
https://www.uppsala.se/contentassets/7608aa284a64481bb52150f3fa6ee3a7/funktionsprogram-for-nytt-vard--och-omsorgsboende-for-aldre_slutversion_210924.pdf

to scale; figures and furniture without a dimension are illustrative only. No values are taken from Neufert (catalogue policy: page references only).
